prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt a photo grid for 20 and 20,000 items on iPhone and iPad. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS/iPadOS. Grid uses a fixed six columns even in a narrow phone window, selection clears on rotation and thumbnails are the only source of image meaning. An empty album is an unexplained blank screen.

criteria.task_completion: Specify adaptive cells, persistent selection identity, accessible item descriptions and meaningful empty/loading states; retain efficient scanning and avoid asserting measured performance.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the collections guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify adaptive cells, persistent selection identity, accessible item descriptions and meaningful empty/loading states; retain efficient scanning and avoid asserting measured performance.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
